name: Knowledge: Herbalism + Mining treasures
about: The 16 one-off Midnight Herbalism and Mining treasures, 3 knowledge points each (48 in all), ordered zone by zone. Coordinates from Method's treasure guide. Use the 3 Thalassian Phoenix Plumes in your bags first (5 Herbalism points each).
